contentText: Officials representing Ukraine, Russia and the United States are set to meet in Abu Dhabi on Friday for their first trilateral talks on security issues in a bid to end the war in Ukraine. Diplomatic efforts to end the near four-year-long war have gained momentum in recent months, but Moscow and Kyiv remain deeply divided on the key issue of territory. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
